aboutText: I study Software Engineering (B.Tech, second year, third semester) at NIAT Jaipur – Vivekananda Global University in Jaipur, Rajasthan, maintaining an 8.65 CGPA after graduating Class XII with 86.6%.

My engineering work merges three distinct domains: Full-Stack & Applied AI, Edge Robotics & Embedded Hardware, and Entrepreneurial Delivery. At Maggieaurcode, I build and deploy production websites with AI capabilities for local businesses. In robotics, I lead Team RoboLyte developing edge-AI inspection rovers with thermal and gas telemetry.

Winner of the SKIT IEEE 26 Hackathon (₹35,000 first prize) and recipient of ₹20,000 VGU startup funding as team leader, I focus on building verified, testable engineering solutions without fabricated claims.
